historic_survey.note: Contributor to the South Van Ness Avenue–Shotwell–Folsom Streets (SVN-S-F) California Register eligible district (1477 15th St). Criterion A: an isolated pocket of pre-1906 buildings left unharmed by the earthquake and fire, near a larger surviving group at 573 South Van Ness Avenue. Integrity is moderate; the survey says the district is not likely to qualify for the National Register. Contributor to the Inner Mission Commercial Corridor locally significant area (1477 15th St). Formerly called the 16th Street Commercial Corridor. Criterion C: San Francisco's largest concentration of residential-over-commercial and small-scale commercial buildings, spanning both pre-1906 and post-disaster construction, dated c. 1870s–1931.
